node.title: L1 bounded Plotkin-excess payment
node.statement: Let E=N+b-4ell>=0 for the combined core/background constant-weight code. Partition contributors by their pattern on any E coordinates. Puncturing within one pattern class preserves distance and leaves length 4ell with distance at least 2ell, so Rankin gives at most 2(4ell) members per class and at most 2^(E+1)(N+b-E) contributors per exact support cell. Hence every fixed (petal polarity, Plotkin excess) box is polynomial per chart, and a counterfamily must have N+b-4ell unbounded. Officially, (r-1)E=(M-3(r-1)+1)ell-r(g+1).
